title: Lean Beef and Broccoli Rice
seoTitle: Lean Beef and Broccoli Rice | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Flat-top stir-fry with flank steak, broccoli, and brown rice
subtitle: Flat-top stir-fry with flank steak, broccoli, and brown rice
description: Flank steak strips sear fast with broccoli florets in a ginger-garlic soy sauce, served over brown rice for a classic hall stir-fry line.

steps.title: Cook brown rice
steps.instruction: Simmer brown rice until tender and chewy, 35–40 minutes. Fluff with fork and hold warm in rice cooker until stir-fry is ready.

steps.title: Blanch broccoli
steps.instruction: Boil broccoli florets 2 minutes until bright green and slightly tender. Drain and shock in ice water so florets stay crisp, not mushy.

steps.title: Mix stir-fry sauce
steps.instruction: Whisk soy sauce, oyster sauce, broth, cornstarch, half the garlic, and ginger until smooth with no starch lumps at the bottom.

steps.title: Sear beef in batches
steps.instruction: Heat wok or skillet over high with vegetable oil. Sear beef strips 2–3 minutes per batch until browned edges appear, not gray and steaming.

steps.title: Combine and glaze
steps.instruction: Return all beef, add broccoli and sauce. Toss 2–3 minutes until sauce thickens to a glossy coat. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

proTips: Freeze flank 20 minutes for easier thin slicing on a busy prep board.
Do not skip oyster sauce—it adds depth soy alone cannot.
Offer chili crisp at the line for crews who want crunchy heat.
tonightSpread: Fortune cookies if available—crew morale boost.
leftovers: Reheat in skillet with splash of broth to restore sauce gloss.
Beef and broccoli omelet next morning with sriracha.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Familiar takeout flavor without the food-coma. High protein and ready in one wok rotation after calls.
mealPrepNotes: Slice beef against the grain paper-thin. Mix sauce in a bowl before the fire hits the pan. Station: Cook rice first in a cooker—wok stays hot for beef without interruption. Station: Sear beef in two batches; overcrowding steams meat gray instead of browned. Station: Blanch broccoli 2 minutes first for consistent tender-crisp texture at scale.
